ic_name: SD Memory Card (SD Simplified Physical Layer Specification)

spec_provided_observability.name: Card Status Register (CSR)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: 32-bit status bits embedded in every R1 — reports current state + error flags (CRC, illegal command, address, WP_VIOLATION, ECC failure, generic error, locked, ...).

spec_provided_observability.name: SD Status Register (SSR)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: 512-bit detailed status (speed class, AU size, erase parameters, UHS speed grade, video speed class, app performance class, command-queue support).

spec_provided_observability.name: DAT0 busy
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Real-time busy indicator during programming; visible as a LOW level on the line.

spec_provided_observability.name: CMD13 SEND_STATUS
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Polling mechanism for R1 status without affecting state; allowed during programming.

spec_provided_observability.name: Data Response Token (write)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: After every write block on DAT0, card emits a 5-bit Data Response Token: 010 accept / 101 CRC error / 110 write error.

spec_provided_observability.name: OCR busy bit (ACMD41)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Init-time busy / ready handshake on the CMD line.

spec_provided_observability.name: FX_EVENT bit (CSR bit 7)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Function Extension event indication for power-management or vendor-defined events.

scope_observability: Logic-analyzer or oscilloscope probing of CLK / CMD / DAT lines is the standard debug path.
Tuning Block (CMD19) data pattern is fixed and well-known for UHS-I — useful as a sanity probe.
Card Detect (CD/DAT3) pull-up status is visible on the line; ACMD42 toggles the on-card 50 kΩ pull-up.
ate_or_dft: No standard DFT/JTAG path on the SD card edge; vendors use internal scan / BIST that is not visible to the host.
notes: SD does not specify a formal debug architecture (no scan, no JTAG on the card edge connector). Host-side observability is limited to (a) CSR / SSR reads, (b) DAT0 busy line, (c) CRC mismatch events, and (d) scope/LA probing of the 6-wire SD bus or 4-wire SPI bus.
